mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Connect multiple USB sticks to your XDJ-AZ through a USB hub.
mods.description: Connect a USB hub to your XDJ-AZ and use several USB sticks at the same time. Browse playlists and tracks from each stick directly on the controller, just as you would with a normally connected USB stick. Supports up to eight sticks. Requires XDJ-AZ firmware 2.00.
